import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.sparse.csgraph import connected_components
from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix
from sklearn.metrics import pairwise_distances
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv')
feat=[x for x in df.columns if x!='outcome']
Z=df[feat].values.astype(float); Z=Z/Z.std(0)
D=pairwise_distances(Z)

nn=D.min(1)
print(np.histogram(nn,bins=[0,0.001,0.005,0.01,0.02,0.03,0.05,0.1,0.2,0.5,1,5])[0])
for t in [0.005,0.01,0.02,0.03,0.05,0.1]:
    A=coo_matrix(D<t)
    n,lab=connected_components(A,directed=False)
    print(t,n)

import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['_row']=range(len(df))
key=df.copy(); key['bmi']=key['bmi'].round(1)
feat=[x for x in df.columns if x not in ('outcome','diabetes_pedigree','_row')]
drop=set()
for _,g in key.groupby(feat):
    g=g.sort_values('diabetes_pedigree')
    cluster=[]; last=None
    for idx,row in g.iterrows():
        if last is not None and row['diabetes_pedigree']-last>0.002:
            drop.update(sorted(cluster,key=lambda j: df.loc[j,'_row'])[1:]); cluster=[]
        cluster.append(idx); last=row['diabetes_pedigree']
    drop.update(sorted(cluster,key=lambda j: df.loc[j,'_row'])[1:])
clean=df.drop(index=list(drop)).drop(columns='_row')
print('dropped',len(drop),'kept',len(clean))
print('exact dups left:',clean.duplicated().sum(), ' outcome mean:',round(clean.outcome.mean(),3), ' orig:',round(df.outcome.mean(),3))
clean.to_csv('/home/daytona/workspace/clean_tmp.csv',index=False)
